summary: squeez postinstall fetches and executes remote content from raw.githubusercontent.com
details: Package squeez@1.40.0 declares a postinstall hook (`"postinstall": "node install.js"`) that runs on `npm install`. install.js imports child_process, https, fs, and os; it reads os.homedir() and process.platform, performs `https.get(...)` fetches against `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/...` (referenced at install.js lines 76 and 104), and reads local files via fs.readFileSync/fs.existsSync. Fetching code from a mutable raw.githubusercontent.com URL at install time and executing under Node with access to the process environment and home directory constitutes install-time remote code inclusion: the content served by the remote path can change without any republish of this package, and any code fetched runs with the installer's user privileges. This is not the shape of a pinned first-party publisher SDK — the source is a mutable GitHub raw endpoint, not a versioned registry artifact.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
